title: Symposium: seeking the crescent of Ramadan between Sharia and astronomy, under the patronage of the Grand Mufti
excerpt: Under the auspices of His Eminence, the Grand Mufti of the Kingdom, Sheikh Abdul Karim Al-Khasawneh The President of the Jordanian Astronomical Society and the Secretary General of the Arab Federation for Space and…
body:
Under the auspices of His Eminence, the Grand Mufti of the Kingdom, Sheikh Abdul Karim Al-Khasawneh
The President of the Jordanian Astronomical Society and the Secretary General of the Arab Federation for Space and Astronomy are honored
His Excellency Dr. Eng. Awni Muhammad Al-Khasawneh
By inviting you to attend the scientific symposium entitled
Investigate the crescent of the holy month of Ramadan between Islamic law and astronomy
To be held at half past four in the evening on Monday 20-4-2020 corresponding to 26-Shaaban 1441 AH in the virtual space of the Jordanian Astronomical Society

Scientific symposium program
4: 30-6: 30 pm

Event Schedule 4:30 – 6:30 PM
Verses from the Wise Remembrance: Recited by our astronomer Hani Al-Daliea / The Jordanian Astronomical Society
Welcome speech: His Excellency, President of the Jordanian Astronomical Society and Secretary of the Arab Federation for Space and Astronomy, Dr. Awni Al-Khasawneh
Speech by the sponsor of the ceremony: His Eminence the Grand Mufti of the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, Sheikh Abdul Karim Al-Khasawneh
A lecture entitled “Astronomical Calculations of Central Conjugation by Time of Amman and its Suburbs”: Dr. Ammar Al-Skaji / Vice-President of the Jordanian Astronomical Society
Lecture titled “The Possibility and Criteria for Sighting the Crescent”: The Astronomer Engineer Mohammed Odeh, Director of the International Astronomy Center
A lecture entitled “Expectations of the Beginning of Ramadan and Dhul Hijjah for the year 2020 in Islamic Countries and Organizations”: Prof. Dr. Popular Flowers / Jordanian Astronomical Society
Closing word
The master of the seminar: Astronomer Dalal Lalla
Register in advance for this event:

The Arab Federation for Space and Astronomy
The Jordanian Astronomical Society (Jordan)
International Astronomy Center
Astronomy Development Office in the Arab Region
Center for Theoretical and Astrophysics
Note: The maximum capacity for the virtual room is 100 people, the selection is made according to priority in registration and the rest will be followed through social platforms.
